definitions.explanation: Multiple days; can refer to the passing of time or daily activities.

examples.japanese: {日々|ひび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{日々|ひび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{日々|ひび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{戻|もど}らない→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。

⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日々|ひび}⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Technology is advancing day by day.

examples.english: I can feel my Japanese getting better day by day.

notes:
{日々|ひび} is a literary/formal word meaning "days" or "daily," formed by reduplication of ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧.

USAGE TYPES:
1. Noun: multiple days, the passing days
2. Adverb: day by day, daily

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {日々|ひび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: daily life
- {日々|ひび}⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grow day by day
- {日々|ひび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to spend one's days
- ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{日々|ひび}: busy days

REGISTER:
More literary and formal than ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧. Often used when reflecting on time passing or in written/poetic contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧: every day (neutral, everyday usage)
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧: daily life, everyday (noun)
- ⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧: year by year (same pattern)
